content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available - 1 for Junior Resident (Dental).

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident : BDS from a recognized university/institution. Must possess a valid Registration Certificate from any State Dental Council. Must have completed compulsory rotatory internship after 03.09.2024. Maximum tenure of junior resident is for a period of one year only including any service rendered as junior resident earlier on ad-hoc/regular basis in any recognized institution.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years for UR. Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years OBC: 3 years Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan): 5 years In case of non-availability of fresh candidates, the maximum age limit for JR will be 40 years.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Pay matrix of level 10 (Rs.56,100-1,77,500/-) plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written Exam Tie-breaker criteria: Candidate scoring higher marks in the final year BDS examination, then candidates with higher age.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Resident (Dental) post is 03 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they report for registration within the specified time frame on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident (Dental) position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior Resident (Dental) position, candidates must possess a BDS degree from a recognized university or institution and hold a valid registration certificate from any State Dental Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident (Dental) post is 30 years for the Unreserved category. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Disabilities.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Resident (Dental) post at Dr Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (Dental) role?
faq.answer: The Junior Resident (Dental) will be placed in the pay matrix of Level 10, with a salary ranging from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500/- per month, plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to report directly to the specified venue on the registration date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original certificates, a set of self-attested photocopies of their documents, ID proof, educational certificates, and passport-sized photographs to the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Exam. In case of a tie in scores, the candidate with higher marks in the final year BDS examination will be preferred, followed by candidates with higher age.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Conference Hall, First Floor, Administrative Block, DHAS Hospital, Delhi - 110032.
